method: 0.90 * v10s + 0.05 * AnEn + 0.05 * ECMWF physical (rows where both exist; otherwise v10s)
anen: Delle Monache 2013 / Alessandrini 2015 analog ensemble, group cf, N=20, +-1h window, predictors gx_dsw, gx_tcc (GFS 00Z D-1 box), wa_cloud, wb_cloud (provided), e0 (box centre); analogs only from days < 2025-06-01
physical: Lorenz 2009/2011 style: PR(hour) median over training hours 2024-03..2025-05 x group capacity x ECMWF hourly SSRD box mean / 1000
cv: 12-month OOF (rolling, test-transferable PR): 11 months v10 158.884M -> 156.773M (-1.33%, 9/11); LOMO weight choice -0.69% (8/11)

sources: ECMWF IFS open data (CC BY 4.0), AWS ecmwf-forecasts, 12Z D-2 run, ssrd +36h/+42h (target day 09-15 KST)
NOAA GFS 0.25 (public domain), AWS noaa-gfs-bdp-pds, 00Z D-1 run, f030 DSWRF/TCDC 24-30h average (target day 09-15 KST)
sources.aggregation: fixed boxes 34-38N/126-130E (+N/S halves), no site coordinates

added_in_v10.source: NOAA GFS 1.0deg (public domain, AWS noaa-gfs-bdp-pds), 00Z D-1 run, leads 21-36h, fixed-box means 34-38N/126-130E + N/S halves (no site coordinates)

added.source: ECMWF IFS open data (CC BY 4.0), official Google Cloud mirror storage.googleapis.com/ecmwf-open-data (same files as AWS/ECMWF), 12Z D-2 run, SSRD steps 30..48 h -> 3 h means for target-day KST 04..21, fixed boxes 34-38N/126-130E (+N/S), no site coordinates

base_v10s.note: v10 with E and B21 averaged over seeds 0,1,2,3 (final_site E_gx+E_gx_s23, B21_gx+B21_gx_s23), same external inputs as v10 (GFS 00Z D-1 box hourly + day-model box features ECMWF 12Z D-2 / GFS 00Z D-1)
